---
title: "Contrarian Indicator Alert"
date: "2006-05-26"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

[Barry Ritholtz](http://bigpicture.typepad.com/comments/2006/05/uhoh_the_econom.html "Barry Ritholtz") points to one of our favourite contrarian indicators, but one which is giving mixed signals.  Do we run with the bear on the cover, or the [inside story](http://www.economist.com/opinion/displaystory.cfm?story_id=6975848 "inside story") which urges us to ‘stare down the bear’?  Perhaps *The Economist* has at last recovered some semblance of its former intellectual modesty (but I’m staying bearish on that question).
